title: Open-Meteo historical archive, Rotorua, 13-14 February 2015-2026
claims: For the grid point -38.13708, 176.23988 (Rotorua, model elevation 291 m) over 13-14 February of 2015-2026, 24 days: daily maximum 15.9-29.9 C with a median of 22.45 C; daily minimum 11.6-19.5 C with a median of 14.85 C.
Over the same 24 days, 10 reached 1 mm of precipitation, 7 reached 5 mm, and the maximum daily total was 64.8 mm.
These are gridded model values, not on-course measurements, and the 2027 race-week weather was unknown at the check date.
